output.summary: Provide the required physician letter of medical necessity and clinical progress notes, then follow the appeal steps outlined in the accepted precedent. The rejected precedents do not apply because they involve different coverage lines or an outdated clause version.

items.text: Provide a physician letter of medical necessity as required by clause C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT.
Submit clinical progress notes demonstrating functional improvement per clause C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT.
Obtain a physician letter of medical necessity.
Attach the clinical progress notes to the appeal.
Request a peer-to-peer review with the treating physician.
The DME precedent (F-DME-NECESSITY) does not apply because it concerns durable medical equipment, not physiotherapy.
The emergency‑room precedent (F-ER-NECESSITY) is irrelevant; it addresses ER coverage, not physiotherapy.
The prior physiotherapy notes precedent (F-PHYSIO-NOTES) is rejected due to version drift – it was based on clause C-2025-PHYSIO-LIMIT, not the current C-2026-PHYSIO-LIMIT.
